name: ESTIC DST Science & Technology Portal
description: A unified national scientific database and portal that aggregates, catalogs, and indexes research publications, patents, and S&T metrics across Indian institutions.
challenge: Researchers and government bodies faced highly fragmented publication directories, slow cross-domain queries, and manual patent compilation processes.
solution: Built a high-performance portal linking major national research databases, integrating Elasticsearch query nodes, and implementing automated PDF cataloging.

testimonial.quote: The ESTIC clearinghouse portal has transformed national scientific data search, reducing publication retrieval times by over 60%.
testimonial.author: Dr. A. K. Singh
testimonial.outcome: National research search times reduced by 60%

researchText: We mapped user journeys for over 15,000 national researchers. Analysis revealed that critical science directories were silos with incompatible data models. To resolve this, we formulated a unified metadata schema linking journals, patents, and grants, enabling fast, cross-institution indexing.
designText: Designed a high-density, accessible layout using slate-gray editorial spacing and clear typographic hierarchies. Custom search suggestion drawers and dynamic filter tags were optimized to meet national accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA).
developmentText: Built a cluster of Elasticsearch nodes to index millions of records synchronously. Integrated Django REST APIs with PostgreSQL database partitioning to ensure search query responses remain under 200ms across massive datasets.

name: CACM 2026 Conference Portal
description: The official registration, scheduling, and abstract submission portal for the 2026 International Conference on Advanced Clay Materials.
challenge: Legacy conference sites relied on manual email-based abstract reviews and static bank transfers, creating significant administrative overhead.
solution: Developed a custom responsive website incorporating online fee payment systems, speaker lists, and automated peer-review abstract dashboards.

testimonial.quote: Our registration fees and abstract reviews were automated seamlessly, eliminating 90% of manual coordination work.
testimonial.author: Prof. R. Prasad

researchText: Analyzed abstract submission systems from top international scientific congresses. We realized academic reviewers required a visual dashboard to comment, rate, and approve/reject abstracts without leaving their browser, while authors needed immediate PDF confirmation.
designText: Crafted an editorial website utilizing deep navy tones and clay-orange highlights. Large, readable session calendars let attendees filter speaker topics by discipline, scaling smoothly to mobile devices for on-site navigation during the event.
developmentText: Implemented an automated PDF parsing and upload module in PHP. Integrated Razorpay payment gateways with direct webhook confirmation, automatically triggering SQL receipt updates and instant email confirmations.

name: ARCI Advanced Research Corporate Portal
description: A comprehensive web portal showcasing ARCI's material science breakthroughs, patent directories, research labs, and technology transfer opportunities.
challenge: Valuable research patents and metallurgical technologies were locked in static tables, rendering tech transfer pipelines opaque for private companies.
solution: Redesigned the portal into an interactive directory with prominent tech transfer showcases, scientist directories, and contact forms for joint ventures.

testimonial.quote: Our partnerships with commercial manufacturing firms grew substantially following the tech directory launch.
testimonial.author: Dr. Tata N. Rao

researchText: Conducted UX audit of existing metallurgy databases. We discovered corporate buyers exited the site due to unstructured patent listings. We proposed a structured, searchable B2B Technology Transfer catalog that highlights commercial viability.
designText: Adopted a structured, tech-forward aesthetic using industrial gray hues and emerald-green highlights. The design features a robust card grid highlighting patent status, licensing terms, and research divisions with high readability.
developmentText: Built a fast database directory on PostgreSQL with indexed searches. Optimized Apache server configurations with gzip compression, browser caching headers, and responsive CSS to handle heavy traffic peaks.

name: Incap Limited Capacitors B2B Catalogue
description: A B2B product catalogue and distributor tracking platform for Incap Limited, a leading manufacturer of electrolytic capacitors.
challenge: Industrial engineers struggled to find specific capacitor models, capacitor dimensions, or request pricing in a disorganized B2B product matrix.
solution: Built a structured B2B catalogue with custom filter options (voltage, capacitance, size) along with a B2B cart request and datasheet download system.

testimonial.quote: Our distributor orders and bulk capacitor pricing requests doubled once our technical B2B catalog was rolled out.
testimonial.author: S. Chandra
testimonial.outcome: Inbound B2B lead counts increased by 200%

researchText: Analyzed B2B procurement behaviors of industrial electrical engineers. They require instant access to technical datasheets and a multi-variant filter (Voltage: 10V-450V, Capacitance: 1uF-10000uF) to identify stock numbers under 10 seconds.
designText: Engineered a clean B2B portal using high-contrast borders and data tables. Added visual capacitor dimensional diagrams alongside product tables for immediate size reference, styled with modern typography.
developmentText: Created a single-page app utilizing React for real-time parametric filtering. Powered by Node.js/Express REST API endpoints and MongoDB database indexing to deliver lightning-fast B2B catalog queries.

name: APADCL Airports Infrastructure Portal
description: The official portal for APADCL displaying tenders, civil airport progress maps, and aviation policy frameworks for greenfield airports.
challenge: Important commercial tenders and project updates were buried in confusing lists, delaying developer bids and causing audit headaches.
solution: Redesigned the site with a live active tenders noticeboard, interactive airport project status maps, and official news streams.

testimonial.quote: Bidding compliance and airport infrastructure project updates are now highly transparent and easily accessible for developers.
testimonial.author: Shri V. Prasanna

researchText: Analyzed friction in government bidding portals. Main issue was access to live tenders on mobile devices. We mapped a streamlined navigation flow placing Active Tenders on the homepage and building a search engine filtering projects by status.
designText: Designed a clean, authoritative corporate layout in corporate sky blue and white. Added structural progress metrics cards and interactive map overlays to show airport development phases.
developmentText: Coded a high-speed database in MySQL for tender query indexes, linking it to light PHP endpoints. Used vanilla JavaScript for the tender notifications feed, maintaining load speed at under 1.2s.
